show.description:
Adhoori Beti” is a high-emotion family drama revolving around identity, abandonment, and emotional violence.
The show explores how adopted children are treated as “temporary” love until blood relations return.
Niharika, a physically challenged girl, becomes the scapegoat for every family sin.
Mahira, the biological daughter, represents entitlement masked as innocence.
The narrative questions: Is family defined by blood or by conscience?
Through psychological trauma, silent endurance, and moral conflicts, the story exposes hypocrisy within elite families.
Every episode peels another layer of truth, guilt, and suppressed cruelty.
